verdict.rationale: Paxos documents travel-rule-style handling: collecting and transmitting beneficiary information for above-threshold crypto transfers. Its Identity API covers onboarding decisions for persons and institutions. Nothing in the pack names sanctions screening or wallet/address risk checks, so only one of the three named compliance functions is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented sanctions/OFAC screening, wallet or blockchain-address risk scoring, explicit travel-rule naming and protocol details, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, the platform documents its sanctions screening, wallet risk checks, and travel-rule handling — compliance machinery named specifically, not waved at

citations.quote: Collect and transmit beneficiary information for above-threshold crypto transfers.
Create a person identity and handle the onboarding decision on the Paxos Platform.
